about: A military expedition to the center of the Zone has mysteriously disappeared. Your task, as a special service operative in S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat – the final part of the original trilogy, is to figure out the reason behind the disappearance and determine the status of the personnel. This edition has been recalibrated for a journey on console.

Play your part in the final installment of the original S.T.A.L.K.E.R trilogy, uncovering the further fate of the Zone and the stalkers in it. Survive and unravel the mysteries of these lands, blending action, horror, survival, and role-playing elements within the dark Eastern European science fiction setting.

The heartlands of the Zone are now open for exploration to the most experienced and daring stalkers. Forge your path through the swampy Zaton, the industrial "Jupiter" plant, the ghost town of Prypiat, and the top-secret catacombs untouched since the catastrophe.

The Zone grows ever more unpredictable and treacherous, warping reality itself. Seek shelter during sudden emissions and confront new types of anomalies and mutants. Confront the Chimera, the fearsome predator of the night, and the telekinetic Burer, lurking in the darkest recesses.

Encounter numerous vagabonds and inhabitants along your journey. Be discerning and cautious in your interactions; some may aid your investigation or shed light on the Zone's mysteries. Remember, your decisions will shape their futures and destinies.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
